name: Crate of Ghost Magnets
summary: The Crate of Ghost Magnets draws Magram ghosts toward a gathering place in the Valley of Bones. Hornizz Brimbuzzle hopes the captured ghost-o-plasm will fetch a fine price from the centaurs.

sections.title: Ghostly Bait
sections.body: Hornizz Brimbuzzle gives you the Crate of Ghost Magnets for use in the Valley of Bones. Set between the two Dead Goliaths, it draws Magram ghosts close enough for their ghost-o-plasm to be gathered. Hornizz means to sell the strange substance to the centaurs.

faq.answer: The Crate of Ghost Magnets draws Magram ghosts toward it in the Valley of Bones.

faq.q: Who gives you the Crate of Ghost Magnets?
faq.answer: Hornizz Brimbuzzle gives you the Crate of Ghost Magnets.
The crate is used in the Valley of Bones, between the two Dead Goliaths.
Hornizz hopes to sell ghost-o-plasm to the Magram centaurs.
